files.rationale: Both sides added this file with the same exports (McpCommand, McpAddCommand); PR A's non-interactive add/remove/list/get/add-json/enable/disable suite, which persists config and is covered by PR A's tests, supersedes PR B's stub interactive add that never saved anything, so PR A's version is kept.
Both sides added the same optional headers record to McpRemote, differing only in description text, so a single headers field is kept (PR B's wording).
Both sides import and register McpCommand, so it is imported and registered once, and PR B's InstallGithubCommand import and registration are added.
Both sides pass configured headers to the SSE transport equivalently, so the single headers: mcp.headers line is kept.
